data.name: Torel Palace Porto
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious 5-Star Stay in the Heart of Porto

Exquisite Amenities: Torel Palace Porto boasts an outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant, and a bar for guests to unwind and enjoy. The concierge service and luggage storage add to the convenience of your stay.

Elegant Rooms: Experience comfort and style in the air-conditioned rooms equipped with modern amenities such as a coffee machine, minibar, and flat-screen TV. Some rooms offer balconies with stunning city views for a truly memorable stay.

Central Location: Situated just 600 meters from Sao Bento Metro Station, this hotel is perfect for exploring Porto's top attractions like Sao Bento Train Station and Ribeira Square. Book now for a luxurious getaway at Torel Palace Porto.
